title: Baked cod puttanesca
summary: Cod fillets baked on a tray of tomatoes, cannellini beans, olives and capers. The beans make it a full meal without a pile of pasta.

equipment.name: Roasting tin or oven dish
equipment.notes: big enough for the fish to sit in one layer

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 190°C. Toss the onion, tomatoes, beans, olives, capers, garlic, oregano and oil in the tin with a pinch of salt.
Roast the vegetable base until the tomatoes slump and the onion softens.
steps.tip: Give the base a head start so the fish doesn't overcook while the vegetables catch up.

steps.instruction: Stir the spinach through the hot base. Season the cod with pepper and the remaining salt and nestle it into the tin. Bake until the fish flakes easily with a fork.
Squeeze over the lemon juice and rest the tin for a couple of minutes. Serve straight from the dish, with the beans and juices.

image.alt: Baked white fish with tomatoes, beans and olives
